note: BH-8255. Read by bin/lib/served-sha-watch.d/30-prodbehind.sh as ${SERVED_SHA_PRODBEHIND_REPEAT_H:-4}: passed to bin/lane-alert.sh as ALERT_REMINDER_S (this many hours times 3600) for the prodbehind:<project> id only, so the open page sends one "still firing" reminder per this many hours while prod stays behind with a failed newest deployment. 0 or a value that is not a whole number falls back to 4 and the fallback is logged.
